Hi team — quick answer and a recommended minimal path.

Policy summary (short):
- Invoice-only is allowed for trial/PO-exempt pilots under $5,000 total expected monthly spend and where the engagement is non-sensitive (no PHI, PCI, regulated datasets).
- Required evidence for invoice-only onboarding:
  • Signed procurement-approval-form (procurement-approval-form.pdf) — includes approver name and billing contact.
  • SSO enabled for the trial org (okta/gsuite link).
  • Org EIN or business registration (vendor intake).
- If any red flags (data sensitivity, reseller relationship, or contract redlines), default to PO + SOW and route to Finance.

Operational steps for CirrusAI:
1) Rishi: send Elena the procurement-approval-form and the vendor intake link.
2) Elena: return the signed approval form + EIN; procurement will validate and mark vendor as invoice-only.
3) Priya: once form received, I’ll approve at my level for <$5k and route to Finance for record.

I’ve attached the approval form and a checklist link. If you want this escalated for an exception above the threshold, we’ll need a one-page justification and head-of-sales approval.

Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: procurement-approval-form.pdf (application/pdf)
